Codex review: needs real behavior proof before merge. _Reviewed September 4, 2026, 6:10 PM ET / 22:10 UTC._ # ClawSweeper review ## What this changes The PR replaces synthetic dashboard-card artwork with lazy near-viewport rendering of each saved dashboard’s real board content in the Control UI gallery. ## Regression provenance Possible regression — probable (reviewed change; failure trace). No predecessor PR is attributed. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Blocked before merge - 7 items remain** Keep this PR open: the prior P1 remains on the unchanged head. A near-viewport gallery card mounts an active board document, so a saved granted MCP App can obtain an app-view lease and create its sandbox bridge despite the decorative card being inert. **Priority:** P1 **Reviewed head:** `0f3ae0fc47f7478e0dee66390f85afa815ccf7d0` ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🧂 unranked krab **(1/6)** | The gallery result is demonstrated for HTML, but the unchanged P1 capability-boundary defect prevents this patch from being merge-ready. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦪 silver shellfish **(2/6)** | Needs real behavior proof before merge: Authority-chain proof required: the submitted OCM screenshots and HTML-only E2E fixture demonstrate rendered HTML, but do not show that a granted MCP App gallery card is prevented from requesting `board.widget.appView`, `mcp.app.view`, or creating its final bridge. After the passive repair, post a redacted after-fix trace for that forbidden path. After adding proof, update the PR body; ClawSweeper should re-review automatically. If it does not, the PR author or someone with repository write access can comment `@clawsweeper re-review`. | | **Patch quality** | 🧂 unranked krab **(1/6)** | Security review found an item that needs attention. | ## Verification | Check | Result | Evidence | |---|---|---| | **Real behavior** | Needs proof | Needs real behavior proof before merge: Authority-chain proof required: the submitted OCM screenshots and HTML-only E2E fixture demonstrate rendered HTML, but do not show that a granted MCP App gallery card is prevented from requesting `board.widget.appView`, `mcp.app.view`, or creating its final bridge. After the passive repair, post a redacted after-fix trace for that forbidden path. After adding proof, update the PR body; ClawSweeper should re-review automatically. If it does not, the PR author or someone with repository write access can comment `@clawsweeper re-review`. | | **Evidence reviewed** | 7 items | Introduced active preview: The introduced gallery markup inserts the new preview component inside each card; that component mounts the canonical board document once near the viewport.
Active lifecycle remains enabled: The board document always passes active=true and MCP App callbacks into the board view; the gallery supplies this same document rather than a passive renderer.
Granted MCP App request path: An active MCP App widget observes its cell and runs its lifecycle; the Gateway provider then requests board.widget.appView for that widget. | | **Findings** | 1 actionable finding | [P1] Keep gallery previews passive | | **Security** | Needs attention | Gallery cards can initialize granted MCP App bridges: The introduced preview enters the ordinary active board path, which may request an MCP App view and initialize a sandbox/AppBridge merely because a card became near-visible. | ## How this fits together The Control UI dashboard gallery receives saved dashboard sessions from the Gateway and links each card to its chat. This change feeds each nearby card into the board renderer, which normally loads widgets and their associated view lifecycles. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Saved dashboard sessions] --> B[Dashboard gallery] B --> C[Near viewport check] C --> D[Preview board renderer] D --> E[Widget lifecycle] E --> F[HTML preview or MCP App bridge] ``` ## Before merge - [ ] **Add real behavior proof** - Needs real behavior proof before merge: Authority-chain proof required: the submitted OCM screenshots and HTML-only E2E fixture demonstrate rendered HTML, but do not show that a granted MCP App gallery card is prevented from requesting `board.widget.appView`, `mcp.app.view`, or creating its final bridge. After the passive repair, post a redacted after-fix trace for that forbidden path. After adding proof, update the PR body; ClawSweeper should re-review automatically. If it does not, the PR author or someone with repository write access can comment `@clawsweeper re-review`. - [ ] **Keep gallery previews passive (P1)** - This introduced card preview mounts `openclaw-board-document`, which always renders an active board. A nearby granted MCP App therefore reaches the existing app-view lifecycle and can create its sandbox bridge; `inert` only decorates the outer card and does not stop that lifecycle. Add a passive preview mode and cover a granted MCP App with assertions that no `board.widget.appView` or bridge setup occurs. - [ ] **Resolve security concern: Gallery cards can initialize granted MCP App bridges** - The introduced preview enters the ordinary active board path, which may request an MCP App view and initialize a sandbox/AppBridge merely because a card became near-visible. - [ ] **Resolve merge risk (P1)** - Merging as-is lets merely scrolling a dashboard gallery activate saved granted MCP Apps and allocate their app-view tickets, sandbox iframes, and bridges outside the user’s opened dashboard context. - [ ] **Complete next step (P2)** - Make gallery previews passive, add a granted-MCP-App regression proving no app-view request or bridge is created, and post redacted after-fix boundary proof. - [ ] **Improve patch quality** - Make the board/view/cell path explicitly passive for gallery previews and add a granted-MCP-App regression asserting no app-view request. - [ ] **Improve patch quality** - Post a redacted after-fix trace showing the near-viewport gallery card does not create an MCP App view or bridge. ## Findings - [P1] Keep gallery previews passive — `ui/src/pages/dashboards/view.ts:56-62` - [high] Gallery cards can initialize granted MCP App bridges — `ui/src/pages/dashboards/view.ts:56`
Agent review details ### Security Needs attention: The diff introduces a concrete capability-boundary regression by mounting active MCP App content in decorative gallery cards. ### PR surface Source -43, Tests +134. Total +91 across 11 files.
View PR surface stats | Area | Files | Added | Removed | Net | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:| | Source | 7 | 209 | 252 | -43 | | Tests | 4 | 145 | 11 | +134 | | Docs | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | | Config | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | | Generated | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | | Other | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | | **Total** | **11** | **354** | **263** | **+91** |
### Review metrics | Metric | Value | Why it matters | |---|---|---| | **Production vs test delta** | production +209/-252 (net -43); tests +145/-11 (net +134) | The feature is net-negative in production overall, but the new renderer crosses the existing MCP App capability boundary without matching negative-path coverage. | ### Merge-risk options **Maintainer options:** 1. **Make gallery previews passive (recommended)** Pass an explicit preview mode through the board renderer and assert that a near-viewport granted MCP App makes no app-view request or bridge. 2. **Pause live gallery rendering** Keep the synthetic gallery scaffold until saved content can be rendered without activating MCP App capabilities. ### Technical review Best possible solution: Add an explicit passive gallery-preview mode that can render safe saved HTML but never starts MCP App lifecycles, requests app views, or creates tool bridges; render non-HTML widgets as inert placeholders if needed. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Yes, from source: create a saved dashboard containing a granted MCP App, browse until its card is near the viewport, and observe the active lifecycle request board.widget.appView followed by mcp.app.view setup. Is this the best way to solve the issue? No. Reusing the fully active board document is not the best gallery renderer; a dedicated passive mode at the board/view lifecycle boundary avoids creating privileged app-view resources for a decorative card. Full review comments: - [P1] Keep gallery previews passive — `ui/src/pages/dashboards/view.ts:56-62` This introduced card preview mounts `openclaw-board-document`, which always renders an active board. A nearby granted MCP App therefore reaches the existing app-view lifecycle and can create its sandbox bridge; `inert` only decorates the outer card and does not stop that lifecycle. Add a passive preview mode and cover a granted MCP App with assertions that no `board.widget.appView` or bridge setup occurs. Confidence: 0.99 Overall correctness: patch is incorrect Overall confidence: 0.99 AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Needs real behavior proof before merge: Authority-chain proof required: the submitted OCM screenshots and HTML-only E2E fixture demonstrate rendered HTML, but do not show that a granted MCP App gallery card is prevented from requesting `board.widget.appView`, `mcp.app.view`, or creating its final bridge. After the passive repair, post a redacted after-fix trace for that forbidden path. After adding proof, update the PR body; ClawSweeper should re-review automatically. If it does not, the PR author or someone with repository write access can comment `@clawsweeper re-review`. - remove `status: ⏳ waiting on author`: Current PR status label is `status: 📣 needs proof`. Label justifications: - `P1`: Scrolling the dashboard gallery can activate a granted application bridge for an unopened dashboard. - `merge-risk: 🚨 security-boundary`: The introduced preview mounts the active board and can obtain MCP App view tickets and bridges rather than remaining decorative. - `rating: 🧂 unranked krab`: Overall readiness is 🧂 unranked krab; proof is 🦪 silver shellfish and patch quality is 🧂 unranked krab. - `status: 📣 needs proof`: The PR needs real behavior proof before ClawSweeper can clear the contributor ask. Needs real behavior proof before merge: Authority-chain proof required: the submitted OCM screenshots and HTML-only E2E fixture demonstrate rendered HTML, but do not show that a granted MCP App gallery card is prevented from requesting `board.widget.appView`, `mcp.app.view`, or creating its final bridge. After the passive repair, post a redacted after-fix trace for that forbidden path. After adding proof, update the PR body; ClawSweeper should re-review automatically. If it does not, the PR author or someone with repository write access can comment `@clawsweeper re-review`. ### Evidence Security concerns: - [high] Gallery cards can initialize granted MCP App bridges — `ui/src/pages/dashboards/view.ts:56` The introduced preview enters the ordinary active board path, which may request an MCP App view and initialize a sandbox/AppBridge merely because a card became near-visible. Confidence: 0.99 What I checked: - **Introduced active preview:** The introduced gallery markup inserts the new preview component inside each card; that component mounts the canonical board document once near the viewport. ([`ui/src/pages/dashboards/view.ts:56`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/0f3ae0fc47f7478e0dee66390f85afa815ccf7d0/ui/src/pages/dashboards/view.ts#L56), [0f3ae0fc47f7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0f3ae0fc47f7478e0dee66390f85afa815ccf7d0)) - **Active lifecycle remains enabled:** The board document always passes active=true and MCP App callbacks into the board view; the gallery supplies this same document rather than a passive renderer. ([`ui/src/components/board/board-document.ts:304`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/0f3ae0fc47f7478e0dee66390f85afa815ccf7d0/ui/src/components/board/board-document.ts#L304), [0f3ae0fc47f7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0f3ae0fc47f7478e0dee66390f85afa815ccf7d0)) - **Granted MCP App request path:** An active MCP App widget observes its cell and runs its lifecycle; the Gateway provider then requests board.widget.appView for that widget. ([`ui/src/components/board/board-widget-cell.ts:153`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/0f3ae0fc47f7478e0dee66390f85afa815ccf7d0/ui/src/components/board/board-widget-cell.ts#L153), [0f3ae0fc47f7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0f3ae0fc47f7478e0dee66390f85afa815ccf7d0)) - **Bridge side effect:** A ready app view requests mcp.app.view, creates a sandbox iframe, and configures an AppBridge; this is not merely decorative content. ([`ui/src/components/mcp-app-view.ts:297`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/0f3ae0fc47f7478e0dee66390f85afa815ccf7d0/ui/src/components/mcp-app-view.ts#L297), [0f3ae0fc47f7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0f3ae0fc47f7478e0dee66390f85afa815ccf7d0)) - **Coverage gap:** The new E2E fixture supplies only an HTML widget and none of the introduced tests mention board.widget.appView or mcp-app, so they cannot detect an activated granted-app preview. ([`ui/src/e2e/dashboard-gallery.e2e.test.ts:44`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/0f3ae0fc47f7478e0dee66390f85afa815ccf7d0/ui/src/e2e/dashboard-gallery.e2e.test.ts#L44), [0f3ae0fc47f7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0f3ae0fc47f7478e0dee66390f85afa815ccf7d0)) - **Current-main comparison:** Current main still renders only the synthetic, non-executing gallery scaffold and has no dashboard-preview module, so it does not already provide this PR’s feature or resolve the introduced boundary. ([`ui/src/pages/dashboards/view.ts:57`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/8918e743cdf83e63fdd1570927da93e4bad33b3d/ui/src/pages/dashboards/view.ts#L57), [8918e743cdf8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8918e743cdf83e63fdd1570927da93e4bad33b3d)) Likely related people: - **Patrick-Erichsen:** Suggested for follow-up; no historical authorship or introduction is verified. (role: unverified routing candidate; confidence: low) - **Shakker:** Suggested for follow-up; no historical authorship or introduction is verified. (role: unverified routing candidate; confidence: low) ### Rating scale | Score | Internal tier | Crab rank | Meaning | |---:|:---:|---|---| | **6/6** | S | 🦀 challenger crab | Exceptional readiness | | **5/6** | A | 🦞 diamond lobster | Very strong readiness | | **4/6** | B | 🐚 platinum hermit | Good normal PR; ordinary maintainer review | | **3/6** | C | 🦐 gold shrimp | Useful, but confidence is limited | | **2/6** | D | 🦪 silver shellfish | Proof or implementation needs work | | **1/6** | F | 🧂 unranked krab | Not merge-ready | | N/A | NA | 🌊 off-meta tidepool | Rating does not apply | Overall follows the weaker of proof and patch quality.
